C1673.title: Credential Leakage via API Misuse in CI/CD Pipelines
C1673.summary: A threat-oriented study reveals that credential leaks in CI/CD pipelines stem from API misuse and YAML misconfigurations. Attackers inject malicious code through supply chain attacks and exploit the exposed credentials for lateral penetration.

references.title: A Threat-Oriented Study of API Security Challenges in CI/CD Pipelines
